title: RecruitFilter: Candidate Screener, Fuzzy Deduplicator & Unicode Sanitizer
target_pain: Recruiting agencies and hiring managers struggle with messy candidate lists, duplicate profiles, weird character encoding issues (like broken '@' symbols or hidden unicode characters), and manual skills-matching overhead.
key_features: Unicode & Character Sanitizer (fixes broken '@' symbols, smart quotes, zero-width spaces)
Multi-format Parser (CSV, TSV, JSON, or Raw Text)
Clean Data Export (CSV, JSON, or Clipboard)
